title: Test Telegram
description: Send a test message to a Telegram chat through the bot of the module, to check the token and the chat ID

chat_id.title: Telegram chat ID
chat_id.description: A group ID like -1001234567890, a user ID, or a public channel like @name

token.title: Telegram bot token
token.description: Token to test before it is saved. Omit to use the saved one.
